su-isat-61079344.d:
Role Purpose
Deliver FWA subscriber acquisition and acquisition revenue through productive, compliant sales territories and channels, strengthening direct-sales execution across 4G and 5G propositions.

Scope of Work
1. Target Cascade — Translate Circle targets into branch, cluster and sales-force objectives by addressable market and product proposition.
2. Field Sales Leadership — Lead branch reviews, pipeline discipline, field coverage, sales quality and corrective action on underperforming territories.
3. Channel Mix — Increase productive direct sales while coordinating with partner-led channels under national commercial direction.
4. Conversion & Activation — Coordinate with delivery teams to move qualified leads and sales orders through successful activation.
5. Sales Force Effectiveness — Partner with capability teams on onboarding, deployment, performance and field coaching.
6. Quality & Controls — Drive compliant selling, valid customer registration and early-life usage quality.

Requirements
Education and experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Strong experience managing consumer field sales, channel productivity and geographically distributed sales teams.

Functional competencies
Territory management; sales forecasting; channel execution; sales quality; coaching. Strong spreadsheet, presentation and reporting literacy appropriate to the role.

Behavioral competencies
Ownership and follow-through; clear communication; collaboration across functions; analytical problem-solving; customer and commercial orientation. Leadership and decision complexity should be assessed in proportion to actual role scope.

su-ptro-61731044.d:
Job Summary

• Plays key role in managing and overseeing commercial aspects of projects, ensuring effective management of contracts, financials, and risks to optimize project success. The main goals are that relevant project division understand and be aware of the contractual rights and obligations under head contract and in respect of Subcontracts.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Assist to prepare “Rights and Obligations Summaries” for both the Head Contracts and Subcontractors for use by the Project team

Project team successfully utilizes the summaries to manage contract compliance and execution.

Manage claims and variations in collaboration with project teams to maximize entitlements and avoid disputes.

Achieve timely submission and approval of claims/variations, ensuring minimal disputes and maximum project entitlements.

Identify and mitigate contractual risks in Head Contracts and Subcontracts, ensuring compliance with project requirements.

Effective risk mitigation strategies implemented, reducing project exposure.

• Drafting and strategizing head contract letters/notices and ensure compliance with contractual requirements and minimizing risks
• Develop standard contract letters/notices for contractual management of subcontractors

Reduction in contract-related issues through clear, timely submission and well-structured notices.

• Setting up the subcontracts/supply agreements in conjunction with the Commercial Manager & SCM
• Implementing standard Subcontract/Supply agreements templates

Formulate and Administer subcontracts, with major compliance refer to Head Contract basis and best practice to protect PTP.

Review and advise on disputes resolution and appraise contractual entitlements of Head and/or subcontract issues, including resolution of disputes.

Satisfactory (win/win) resolution of disputes (client, subcontractor)

Coordinate and facilitate collaboration between commercial, technical, and operational divisions to ensure alignment in contract administration, cost control,risk management, and project execution.

Reduction in contractual disputes or cost overruns due to misalignment across divisions.

In charge during preparation and implementation of Contract Management Plan and Subcontract Management Plan.

Zero major non-compliance issues identified during internal or external audits.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome.
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in construction related discipline, such as Commercial & Legal, Engineer, QS, with demonstrated expertise in contract administration, claims management, and dispute resolution

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 5+ years of experience in contract administration, commercial management, or procurement within construction, engineering, or infrastructure projects.
• Demonstrates ethical behavior, professionalism, and a positive attitude during team collaboration
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to risk identification and resolution
• Working in cross-functional teams across different division
• Excellent negotiation and communication abilities (fluent in English and Bahasa, both verbal and written)
• Attention to detail
• Able and willing to have site placement

Certification

Other Requirements
